name: Nitta Yasuhisa
source:
"I've heard a lot about you from Takatsuki. You're cool, you never make mistakes, you work hard, but you also have a cute subordinate that you just can't help but feel uncomfortable around."

They are good friends and often go out drinking together. Slightly childish and small. He wears the vest outside of ceremonies in order to prioritize ease of movement.

Like Takatsuki, he is an excellent employee and is highly regarded within the company. Although they are in the same year, he respects and admires Takatsuki.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1712864842099662853]
